title: fix(examples/crm): remove `as any` cast from objectstack.config.ts
body:
`examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts` ended with `as any`, bypassing `defineStack` type checking entirely. The config is already fully compliant with the expected type — the cast was unnecessary.

- **`examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts`**: `} as any)` → `})`
- **`ROADMAP.md`**: Mark item complete under P0.1

All 4383 tests pass. No type errors in the config after removal.

> ### 风险
> - 有 bug 时类型异常不会被 IDE/编译时发现，最终代码合入会导致线上渲染异常（如 columns/fields）

> 
> ### 修复建议
> - 保持所有元数据严格按 `Parameters<typeof defineStack>[0]` 类型定义。
> - 请调用 `as Parameters<typeof defineStack>[0]` 或完全去除 `as any` 并修正类型错误。
> - 配合类型校验，可提升大家的开发体验，减少不可见风险。
